results.rationale: Consistency: most original stone positions are replaced and a large black slab covers the board, destroying the original game layout. Instruction: rather than adding one winning stone to the left end of the existing four-black row, the edit replaces the position with many stones on a slab. Knowledge: Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: the edited arrangement has coherent rounded stones, textured slab and lighting without visible rendering defects.

Consistency: gray ground and dark grip tape remain, but the deck pose/shape and original wheel arrangement change markedly. Instruction: wheels are added, yet the broken jagged front deck remains unrepaired, so the skateboard is not completed. Quality: multiple ghosted extra wheels and ambiguous axle attachments create distracting structural errors.
